output.question: What settlements has Wells Fargo reached?
output.answer: Major Wells Fargo settlements include an $85 million investor settlement approved May 21, 2026, and a $110 million shareholder-derivative settlement approved May 15, 2026, concerning hiring and lending practices. A $185 million settlement over allegedly placing mortgage borrowers into COVID-19 forbearance without informed consent became effective February 15, 2025. A separate $1 billion securities settlement was approved September 8, 2023, with its third distribution occurring September 18, 2026. On December 20, 2022, Wells Fargo Bank resolved a CFPB enforcement action involving $3.7 billion in consumer redress and penalties for auto-loan, mortgage and deposit-account misconduct. On February 21, 2020, Wells Fargo agreed to a $3 billion resolution of DOJ and SEC investigations into unauthorized accounts and related sales practices.

key_facts.fact: As of May 21, 2026, the court approved an $85 million investor class-action settlement; defendants agreed to pay without admitting liability.

As of May 15, 2026, the $110 million derivative settlement concerning hiring and lending practices had final approval. It provides $100 million in mortgage assistance and $10 million payable by directors' insurers to Wells Fargo.
The $185 million COVID-19 mortgage-forbearance settlement became effective February 15, 2025; it addresses allegations of forbearances imposed without informed consent.
The $1 billion securities settlement received final approval September 8, 2023; the administrator reports a third distribution on September 18, 2026.
On December 20, 2022, the CFPB announced a $3.7 billion enforcement resolution against Wells Fargo Bank, comprising more than $2 billion in consumer redress and a $1.7 billion civil penalty.
On February 21, 2020, Wells Fargo & Co. and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. agreed to pay $3 billion to resolve criminal and civil investigations into unauthorized accounts and sales practices.

caveats: This is a selection of major settlements, not an exhaustive history or a claim that these are the latest agreements reached.
Wells Fargo & Company and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. are distinct legal entities; the bank is specifically identified where it was the regulatory respondent.
The $110 million derivative settlement is not entirely a payment by Wells Fargo to claimants: it includes mortgage assistance and an insurer payment to Wells Fargo.
Settlement totals are not individual payouts; fees, expenses, eligibility rules and distribution procedures vary.
Approval, effective dates and payment dates are different milestones. The listed amounts do not establish that claims remain open.
